About Me

Hello! I'm Jasmine Ceny, a multidisciplinary individual with passions spanning science, engineering, fashion, performing arts, and community engagement.

I love exploring different interests and, most importantly, turning my passions into projects. Whether it's experimenting with scientific ideas, designing fashion inspired by culture, performing traditional dances, or bringing people together through community initiatives, I enjoy finding new ways to learn, create, and express myself.

Creative Director

CreativeDirector

MyNight 2026 is a signature event organized by Malaysian Student Association (MySA) in University of Wisconsin-Madison.

As the Creative Director, I led the social media promotion for our event and shaped the creative direction of the theatre production, including the props, costumes and wardrobe for our cast. I managed the media documentation before, during and after the event, and handled the full shoot for the pre-recorded scenes in our show, not just the costuming. A highlight of the role was also being the fashion designer for our runway fashion show, which was integrated into the MyNight 2026 theatre production.

Project Highlights

Project Highlights

This collection is heavily inspired by elements of Malaysian heritage: culture, history, architecture and folklore. These are my personal favourites out of the 12 designs: the dress inspired by our national flower, the hibiscus; the dress with lights inspired by the bright, colourful becas (trishaws) of Malacca; the skirt made from newspaper, inspired by the history of printing in Penang; and the combination of kain batik and a strong silhouette, inspired by adat perpatih, a matrilineal custom brought to Malaysia by the Minangkabau, in which family lineage and ancestral land pass down through women.

Choreographer

choreographer

I've had a passion for cultural arts and performances since childhood, and I channel that passion into choreography that celebrates tradition, storytelling, and the beauty of movement.

Yes to Pink Gala 2023

Choreographed a solo Ngajat Atas Mangkuk performance for a breast cancer awareness charity event hosted by Rotary Club Malaysia 2023.

Around The World Festival 2023

As part of my contribution of Cultural Art Performers (Tradisi) Club of Taylor’s Lakeside Campus, I helped choreographed a Borneo Fusion Dance for our performance in ATW Festival 2023.

Malaysian Festival (MFest) Penn-State University 2024

Represented UW-Madison to perform in Penn-State University a Malaysian Contemporary Dance.

Malaysian Student Association (MySA 25/26)

Being the main choreographer of cultural performances for all the events under MySA 25/26.
